_comment: Extra seccomp rules merged on top of docker/seccomp-default.json (moby v24.0.7) by scripts/build_seccomp_profile.sh. defaultAction stays SCMP_ACT_ERRNO (matches docker default); these extras only ADD new SCMP_ACT_ERRNO matches that are NOT covered by the default profile (NETLINK_NETFILTER netlink socket — used by nft / netfilter shaping that could otherwise reach /proc/net/* control planes outside iptables-legacy).
